title: Multi-block parallel arms export only their first block — the rest are dropped behind a non-blocking warning
existing_state: The canvas lets users chain several blocks inside a parallel arm, but TryGenerateContainerFromGraph emits only `branchChain[0]` per arm, adding a Warning diagnostic 'Parallel branch contains multiple sequential nodes; exporting the first node only' (FlowCanvasBridge.cs:2257-2281). Warnings don't fail the export (Success = no errors), so Apply/Run proceeds and txtCommand is overwritten with YAML missing blocks 2+ of every arm (Form1.cs:6966-6969). The dropped blocks remain visible on the canvas until the next reload from YAML, at which point they vanish — delayed, easy-to-miss data loss of canvas-authored work.
recommendation: Either (a) escalate this diagnostic to Error so the apply is blocked (consistent with the missing-then/missing-do errors at FlowCanvasBridge.cs:2036-2043, 2083-2090), with a message telling the user the YAML schema runs one step per parallel arm, or (b) make it expressible: auto-wrap a multi-node arm in a nested container step on export. Option (a) is a one-line severity change plus a React-side blocker; (b) needs an executor-compatible wrapping rule.
user_benefit: Stops the canvas from accepting a structure it cannot persist and then quietly amputating it on the next save/run.
